info.title: LargitData Social Media API: Weibo, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin, Threads, Bilibili, Zhihu, Baidu Tieba
info.description: Endpoint reference for the commercial LargitData Social Media API on Weibo, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin, Threads, Bilibili, Zhihu and Baidu Tieba, written from the 2026-10-25 specification snapshot (Bilibili, Zhihu and Baidu Tieba from the 2026-11-21 specification). Data is collected by web crawlers from content publicly published on each platform. Collection endpoints are asynchronous: create a task, poll it by ID, read the results once DONE. API keys are issued after a trial request: https://www.largitdata.com/en/social-media-api/#api-inquiry. Full documentation: https://api.infominer.io/docs

max_pages.description: Maximum first-layer pages (answers for a question, 20 per page; top-level comments for an answer or article, 10 per page); 0 or omitted uses the default.

post_url.description: Zhihu question URL https://www.zhihu.com/question/{id}, answer URL .../question/{id}/answer/{id}, or column-article URL https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/{id}. The query string is removed.

rerun.description: Accepted for consistency with other platforms; every POST creates a new task.
